option_relations.rationale: The option describes arrhythmogenic syncope due to multivessel coronary artery disease, which is not directly related to Long QT syndrome.
The option describes acute myocardial ischemia-induced syncope, which is not directly related to Long QT syndrome.
The option describes ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease, which is not directly related to Long QT syndrome.
The option describes Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome, which is not directly related to Long QT syndrome.
